<script>
(function (w, d) {
  var id = '{{CONST - Meta Pixel ID}}';
  if (!/^\d{8,25}$/.test(id)) return;
  function safePage(url) {
    if (/^\/(?:wp-admin|wp-login\.php|my-account|checkout)(?:\/|$)/i.test(url.pathname)) return false;
    var inquiryRoute = /^(?:\/$|\/(?:request-a-quote|request-a-sample|contact-sales|contact|configure-packaging)\/?$)/.test(url.pathname);
    if (url.hash && !(inquiryRoute && url.hash === '#quote')) return false;
    var parameters = new URLSearchParams(url.search);
    return Array.from(parameters).every(function (entry) {
      var key = entry[0];
      var value = entry[1];
      if (/^utm_(?:source|medium|campaign|id|term|content|source_platform|creative_format|marketing_tactic)$/.test(key)) {
        return /^[a-z0-9 ._+|():-]{1,128}$/i.test(value);
      }
      if (key === 'fbclid') return /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/.test(value);
      if (key === 'gtm_debug') return /^\d{1,20}$/.test(value);
      if (key === 'collection' && /^\/products\/?$/.test(url.pathname)) return /^(?:cups|lids|containers|ware)$/.test(value);
      if (!inquiryRoute) return false;
      if (key === 'packaging_product' || key === 'product') {
        return /^(?:double-wall|single-wall|ripple-wall|dessert|bowls|boxes|other|wc-\d{1,10})$/.test(value);
      }
      if (key === 'packaging_size') return /^\d{1,4}(?:[.-]\d{1,4})? *(?:oz|ml|l)$/i.test(value);
      return key === 'intent' && /^(?:quote|pricing|sample|contact|customize)$/.test(value);
    });
  }
  if (!safePage(w.location)) return;
  if (d.referrer) {
    var referrer = new URL(d.referrer);
    if (referrer.origin === w.location.origin ? !safePage(referrer) : referrer.search || referrer.hash) return;
  }
  function shownVariant(product, button) {
    if (button && /^\d+$/.test(button.dataset.cartId || '')) return button.dataset.cartId;
    var form = product.querySelector('.variations_form');
    if (!form) return '';
    var options = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('select[name^="attribute_"]')).filter(function (select) {
      return select.value;
    });
    if (!options.length) return '';
    var variants;
    try { variants = JSON.parse(form.getAttribute('data-product_variations') || '[]'); }
    catch (error) { return ''; }
    if (!Array.isArray(variants)) return '';
    var matching = variants.filter(function (variant) {
      return variant.attributes && options.every(function (select) {
        var value = variant.attributes[select.name];
        return value === '' || value === select.value;
      });
    });
    return matching.length === 1 && /^\d+$/.test(String(matching[0].variation_id)) ? String(matching[0].variation_id) : '';
  }

  function trackCatalog() {
    if (/^\/products\/?$/.test(w.location.pathname)) {
      if (!w.cups1MetaCatalogViewed) {
        var collection = new URLSearchParams(w.location.search).get('collection') || 'all';
        w.cups1MetaCatalogViewed = true;
        w.fbq('trackSingleCustom', id, 'ViewCategory', { content_category: collection });
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\/product\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(w.location.pathname)) return;
    function send() {
      if (w.cups1MetaContentViewed || w.cups1MetaRevoked || !safePage(w.location)) return;
      var product = d.querySelector('[data-product-detail]');
      if (!product) return;
      var heading = d.getElementById(product.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'));
      var button = product.querySelector('[data-catalog-cart-item]');
      var parent = /(?:^|\s)postid-(\d+)(?:\s|$)/.exec(d.body.className);
      var variationId = shownVariant(product, button);
      var productId = variationId || button && button.dataset.catalogCartItem || parent && parent[1];
      var kind = !variationId && product.querySelector('.variations_form') ? 'product_group' : 'product';
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(productId || '') || !heading) return;
      var lookup = w.cups1CatalogMeasurement;
      (lookup ? lookup.detail(productId, button && button.dataset.catalogCartItem || parent && parent[1]) : Promise.resolve({})).then(function (metadata) {
        if (w.cups1MetaContentViewed || w.cups1MetaRevoked || !safePage(w.location)) return;
        var fields = metadata.fields || {};
        var data = { content_ids: [productId], content_name: heading.textContent.trim(), content_type: kind };
        if (fields.item_category) data.content_category = fields.item_category;
        if (fields.item_sku) data.product_sku = fields.item_sku;
        if (fields.item_variant) data.product_variant = fields.item_variant;
        if (metadata.pricing_mode) data.pricing_mode = metadata.pricing_mode;
        if (metadata.price_band) data.price_band = metadata.price_band;
        if (metadata.price !== undefined) {
          data.value = metadata.price;
          data.currency = metadata.currency;
          data.contents = [{ id: productId, quantity: 1, item_price: metadata.price }];
        }
        w.cups1MetaContentViewed = true;
        w.fbq('trackSingle', id, 'ViewContent', data);
      });
    }
    if (d.readyState === 'complete') send();
    else w.addEventListener('load', send, { once: true });
  }
  if (w.cups1MetaPixel === id) {
    if (w.fbq && w.cups1MetaRevoked) {
      w.fbq('consent', 'grant');
      w.cups1MetaRevoked = false;
      trackCatalog();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (!w.fbq) {
    var queue = function () {
      if (queue.callMethod) queue.callMethod.apply(queue, arguments);
      else queue.queue.push(arguments);
    };
    w.fbq = queue;
    if (!w._fbq) w._fbq = queue;
    queue.push = queue;
    queue.loaded = true;
    queue.version = '2.0';
    queue.queue = [];
    var script = d.createElement('script');
    script.async = true;
    script.src = 'https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js';
    d.head.appendChild(script);
  }
  w.fbq('consent', 'grant');
  w.fbq('set', 'autoConfig', false, id);
  w.fbq('init', id);
  w.cups1MetaPixel = id;
  w.fbq('trackSingle', id, 'PageView');
  trackCatalog();
})(window, document);
</script>

<script>
(function (w, d) {
  function emit(event, payload) {
    w.dataLayer = w.dataLayer || [];
    payload.event = event;
    w.dataLayer.push(payload);
  }

  function displayPrice(amount, minorUnit) {
    if (amount == null || amount === '' || !Number.isInteger(minorUnit) || minorUnit < 0 || minorUnit > 6) return NaN;
    return Number(amount) / Math.pow(10, minorUnit);
  }

  function shownVariant(product, button) {
    if (button && /^\d+$/.test(button.dataset.cartId || '')) return button.dataset.cartId;
    var form = product.querySelector('.variations_form');
    if (!form) return '';
    var options = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('select[name^="attribute_"]')).filter(function (select) {
      return select.value;
    });
    if (!options.length) return '';
    var variants;
    try { variants = JSON.parse(form.getAttribute('data-product_variations') || '[]'); }
    catch (error) { return ''; }
    if (!Array.isArray(variants)) return '';
    var matching = variants.filter(function (variant) {
      return variant.attributes && options.every(function (select) {
        var value = variant.attributes[select.name];
        return value === '' || value === select.value;
      });
    });
    return matching.length === 1 && /^\d+$/.test(String(matching[0].variation_id)) ? String(matching[0].variation_id) : '';
  }

  function viewProduct() {
    var product = d.querySelector('[data-product-detail]');
    if (!product) return;
    var heading = d.getElementById(product.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'));
    var cartButton = product.querySelector('[data-catalog-cart-item]');
    var post = /(?:^|\s)postid-(\d+)(?:\s|$)/.exec(d.body.className);
    var id = shownVariant(product, cartButton) || cartButton && cartButton.dataset.catalogCartItem || post && post[1];
    var name = heading && heading.textContent.trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(id || '') || !name) return;
    var lookup = w.cups1CatalogMeasurement;
    (lookup ? lookup.detail(id, cartButton && cartButton.dataset.catalogCartItem || post && post[1]) : Promise.resolve({})).then(function (metadata) {
      var item = Object.assign({ item_id: id, item_name: name, quantity: 1 }, metadata.fields || {});
      if (metadata.price !== undefined) item.price = metadata.price;
      emit('cups1_product_view', {
        items: [item], currency: metadata.currency || null, value: metadata.price === undefined ? null : metadata.price,
        product_category: item.item_category || null, pricing_mode: metadata.pricing_mode || 'unknown', price_band: metadata.price_band || null
      });
    });
  }

  function readCart(event) {
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart', { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(function (response) { return response.ok ? response.json() : null; })
      .then(function (cart) {
        if (!cart || !Array.isArray(cart.items) || !cart.items.length) return;
        var totals = cart.totals || {};
        var currency = totals.currency_code;
        var value = displayPrice(totals.total_items, totals.currency_minor_unit);
        if (!/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(currency || '') || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return;
        var items = cart.items.map(function (entry) {
          var prices = entry.prices || {};
          var price = displayPrice(prices.price, prices.currency_minor_unit);
          if (!/^\d+$/.test(String(entry.id)) || !entry.name || !Number.isInteger(entry.quantity) || entry.quantity < 1 ||
              !Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0 || prices.currency_code !== currency) return null;
          return { item_id: String(entry.id), item_name: entry.name, quantity: entry.quantity, price: price };
        });
        if (!items.every(Boolean)) return;
        var lookup = w.cups1CatalogMeasurement;
        return (lookup ? lookup.decorate(items) : Promise.resolve(items)).then(function (enriched) {
          var categories = new Set(enriched.map(function (item) { return item.item_category; }));
          emit(event, { currency: currency, value: value, items: enriched, product_category: categories.size === 1 ? enriched[0].item_category || null : null });
        });
      }).catch(function () { /* Measurement never interrupts the storefront. */ });
  }

  function track() {
    var path = w.location.pathname;
    if (/^\/product\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(path) && d.body.classList.contains('single-product')) viewProduct();
    else if (/^\/cart\/?$/.test(path) && d.body.classList.contains('woocommerce-cart')) readCart('cups1_cart_view');
    else if (/^\/checkout\/?$/.test(path) && d.body.classList.contains('woocommerce-checkout')) readCart('cups1_checkout_start');
  }

  if (d.readyState === 'complete') track();
  else w.addEventListener('load', track, { once: true });
})(window, document);
</script>

<script>
(function (w) {
  if (w.cups1CatalogMeasurement) return;

  var requests = new Map();
  var departments = new Set(['cups', 'lids', 'containers', 'ware']);

  function getProduct(id) {
    id = String(id || '');
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(id)) return Promise.resolve(null);
    if (!requests.has(id)) {
      var controller = new AbortController();
      var timer = w.setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, 2500);
      var request = w.fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products/' + id, {
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        signal: controller.signal
      }).then(function (response) {
        return response.ok ? response.json() : null;
      }).then(function (product) {
        return product && String(product.id) === id ? product : null;
      }).catch(function () {
        return null;
      }).finally(function () {
        w.clearTimeout(timer);
      });
      requests.set(id, request);
    }
    return requests.get(id);
  }

  function detail(id, knownParent) {
    return Promise.all([
      getProduct(id),
      String(knownParent) === String(id) ? Promise.resolve(null) : getProduct(knownParent)
    ]).then(function (resolved) {
      var product = resolved[0];
      var parent = resolved[1];
      return parent || !product || !product.parent ? resolved : getProduct(product.parent).then(function (fallback) {
        return [product, fallback];
      });
    }).then(function (resolved) {
      var product = resolved[0];
      var parent = resolved[1];
      if (!product && !parent) return {};

      var categoryProduct = parent || product;
      var terms = categoryProduct.categories || [];
      var primary = terms.find(function (term) { return departments.has(term.slug); }) || terms[0];
      var secondary = terms.find(function (term) { return term !== primary; });
      var fields = {};
      if (primary) fields.item_category = primary.name;
      if (secondary) fields.item_category2 = secondary.name;
      if (product && product.sku) fields.item_sku = product.sku;
      if (product && product.variation) fields.item_variant = product.variation;

      var result = { fields: fields };
      if (!product) return result;

      var priceData = product.prices || {};
      var minor = priceData.currency_minor_unit;
      var amount = /^\d+$/.test(String(priceData.price)) && Number.isInteger(minor) && minor >= 0 && minor <= 6
        ? Number(priceData.price) / Math.pow(10, minor) : NaN;
      if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || !/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(priceData.currency_code || '') || !product.price_html) {
        result.pricing_mode = !product.price_html ? 'quote_only' : 'unknown';
      } else if (product.type === 'variable' || product.type === 'grouped') {
        result.pricing_mode = 'variant_required';
      } else {
        result.pricing_mode = product.is_purchasable && product.is_in_stock ? 'priced' : 'unavailable';
        result.price = amount;
        result.currency = priceData.currency_code;
        result.price_band = amount < 100 ? 'under_100' : amount < 250 ? '100_to_249' : amount < 500 ? '250_to_499' : '500_plus';
      }
      return result;
    });
  }

  function decorate(items) {
    return Promise.all(items.map(function (item, index) {
      if (index >= 15) return Promise.resolve(item);
      return detail(item.item_id).then(function (metadata) {
        return Object.assign({}, item, metadata.fields || {});
      });
    }));
  }

  w.cups1CatalogMeasurement = { detail: detail, decorate: decorate };
})(window);
</script>

<script>
(function (w) {
  var layer = w.dataLayer;
  if (!Array.isArray(layer)) return;
  var action, preferences;
  for (var i = layer.length - 1; i >= 0 && (!action || !preferences); i--) {
    var entry = layer[i];
    if (entry && entry.event === 'cups1_cart_add' && !action) action = entry;
    if (entry && entry.event === 'wpconsent_consent_processed' && !preferences) preferences = entry.wpconsentPreferences;
  }
  if (!action || !Array.isArray(action.items) || !preferences || (!preferences.statistics && !preferences.marketing)) return;
  var items = action.items.slice();
  var data = {event: 'cups1_cart_add_enriched', currency: action.currency, value: action.value, items: items};
  (w.cups1CatalogMeasurement ? w.cups1CatalogMeasurement.decorate(items) : Promise.resolve(items)).then(function (enriched) {
    data.items = enriched;
    data.product_category = enriched[0] && enriched[0].item_category || null;
    w.dataLayer.push(data);
  });
})(window);
</script>

<script>
(function (w, d) {
  if (w.cups1EngagementMeasurement) return;
  var path = w.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
  var pageTypes = {
    '/': 'home', '/products': 'catalog', '/for-business': 'business', '/industries': 'business',
    '/request-a-quote': 'quote', '/contact-sales': 'contact_sales', '/request-a-sample': 'sample',
    '/configure-packaging': 'customize', '/contact': 'contact', '/custom-printing': 'customize',
    '/how-it-works': 'resource', '/documents': 'resource', '/faq': 'resource', '/resources': 'resource',
    '/help-center': 'resource', '/about': 'about', '/for-distributors': 'business'
  };
  var pageType = pageTypes[path];
  if (/^\/product\/[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(path)) pageType = 'product';
  if (/^\/(for-business|industries)\/[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(path)) pageType = 'business';
  if (!pageType) return;
  w.cups1EngagementMeasurement = true;

  var thresholds = [25, 50, 75, 90];
  var seenDepths = new Set();
  var startedForms = new WeakSet();
  var pendingScroll = false;
  var callsToAction = {
    '/request-a-quote': 'request_quote', '/contact-sales': 'contact_sales',
    '/request-a-sample': 'request_sample', '/contact': 'contact',
    '/configure-packaging': 'customize', '/custom-printing': 'learn_custom_printing',
    '/products': 'browse_catalog', '/for-business': 'explore_business', '/documents': 'view_documents',
    '/cart': 'open_cart', '/checkout': 'open_checkout'
  };

  function hasStatisticsConsent() {
    var layer = w.dataLayer || [];
    for (var i = layer.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var entry = layer[i];
      if (entry && entry.event === 'wpconsent_consent_processed') {
        return !!(entry.wpconsentPreferences && entry.wpconsentPreferences.statistics === true);
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function emit(event, action, depth, formType) {
    w.dataLayer.push({
      event: event,
      engagement_action: action || null,
      engagement_depth: depth || null,
      engagement_form_type: formType || null,
      engagement_page_type: pageType,
      engagement_page_location: w.location.origin + w.location.pathname,
      engagement_page_referrer: d.referrer ? new URL(d.referrer).origin : ''
    });
  }

  d.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (!event.isTrusted || !hasStatisticsConsent() || !event.target.closest) return;
    var control = event.target.closest('a[href], button, [role="button"]');
    if (!control || control.matches(':disabled, [aria-disabled="true"]')) return;

    var action;
    if (control.matches('[data-catalog-cart-item]')) {
      action = 'add_to_cart_cta';
    } else if (control.matches('a[href]')) {
      var destination = new URL(control.href);
      if (destination.protocol === 'mailto:') action = 'email_link';
      if (destination.protocol === 'tel:') action = 'phone_link';
      if (destination.origin === w.location.origin) {
        var destinationPath = destination.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '');
        action = callsToAction[destinationPath];
        if (/^\/product\/[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(destinationPath)) action = 'open_product';
        if (/^\/(for-business|industries)\/[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(destinationPath)) action = 'explore_business';
      }
    }
    if (action) emit('cta_click', action);
  }, true);

  function recordFormStart(event) {
    if (!event.isTrusted || !hasStatisticsConsent()) return;
    var field = event.target;
    if (!field.matches || !field.matches('input:not([type="hidden"]):not([type="submit"]), select, textarea')) return;
    var form = field.form;
    if (!form || startedForms.has(form)) return;
    var formType = form.closest('[data-inquiry-popup]') ? 'popup' : form.matches('form.inquiry-form') ? 'standalone' : '';
    if (!formType) return;
    startedForms.add(form);
    emit('inquiry_start', null, null, formType);
  }
  d.addEventListener('input', recordFormStart, true);
  d.addEventListener('change', recordFormStart, true);

  w.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    if (pendingScroll || seenDepths.size === thresholds.length) return;
    pendingScroll = true;
    w.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      pendingScroll = false;
      if (!hasStatisticsConsent()) return;
      var height = d.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      if (height - w.innerHeight < 300 || w.scrollY < 100) return;
      var depth = Math.floor((w.scrollY + w.innerHeight) / height * 100);
      thresholds.forEach(function (threshold) {
        if (depth < threshold || seenDepths.has(threshold)) return;
        seenDepths.add(threshold);
        emit('scroll_depth', null, threshold);
        if (threshold === 75 && ['product', 'catalog', 'business', 'customize'].includes(pageType)) {
          emit('content_engaged', null, threshold);
        }
      });
    });
  }, { passive: true });
})(window, document);
</script>
